consideredAndDropped: The classic five (wood, fire, earth, metal, water) with a generating and overcoming cycle was dropped: a cycle forces rigid counters. Frost and Storm were dropped as separate elements in V2.1 (cap of 7): they are the Ice flavour of Water and the Lightning flavour of Wind.
applyRule: No strength/weakness wheel. 12 reactions fire when an attacker's element meets a target's element or status (hit), or when two allied elements stand orthogonally adjacent (adjacent, once per turn at the Boost phase). A reaction triggers once per hit event; area effects once per attack action. Same-element resonance has thresholds at 2 and 4. Enemies carry the element of their bestiary variant (frost = Water/Ice, storm = Wind/Lightning). Flavours add rules but never a new element.

elements.name: Fire
elements.resonance: 2: Fire units +1 ATK on turn 1. 4: all Scorch lasts 1 turn longer.

elements.name: Water
elements.theme: Flow, chain, heal. Ice flavour chills and freezes.
elements.note: Currents, chains and cold. Two flavours: Tide (default) and Ice.
elements.resonance: 2: Chain jump +1 damage. 4: the hero heals 1 per turn.

flavours.name: Ice
flavours.rule: Ice units and enemies are Water. An Ice hit applies Chill (-1 ATK); an Ice hit on a Wet enemy Freezes it (skips its next strike). Fire hits thaw Ice via Steam.

elements.name: Earth
elements.theme: Stone, sand, metal: armor and ground.

elements.name: Wind
elements.theme: Push, fan, reach, spark. Lightning flavour chains.
elements.note: Reach and repositioning. Two flavours: Gust (default) and Lightning.
elements.resonance: 2: all attackers +1 range. 4: the first hit each turn is doubled.

flavours.name: Lightning
flavours.rule: Lightning units and enemies are Wind. A Lightning hit Chains to a neighbour; on a Water or Wet enemy it chains for half damage (Conduct). Earth grounds it (Ground).

elements.name: Light
elements.resonance: 2: Purge reveals Hide on all enemies once per battle. 4: Bond and Herald buffs +1.

elements.name: Shadow
elements.resonance: 2: Hold also affects the neighbour. 4: the hero cannot be struck on turn 1.

reactions.name: Wildfire
reactions.hit: Hit: Burn on a Wood or Burning enemy also spreads to its neighbours.
reactions.adjacent: Wood beside a Fire ally: +1 ATK.

reactions.name: Steam
reactions.hit: Hit: a Fire hit on a Water, Wet or Ice enemy deals +2, thaws it and its neighbours lose 1 ATK.
reactions.adjacent: Fire beside a Water ally: the hero gets +1 block.
reactions.line: Fire on Water bursts into steam.

reactions.name: Bloom
reactions.adjacent: Wood beside a Water ally: +1 ATK and the hero heals 1 per turn.

reactions.name: Conduct
reactions.hit: Hit: a Lightning hit on a Water or Wet enemy chains half damage (min 1). An Ice-Water ally beside a Wind ally spreads its Chill to the target's neighbours.
reactions.adjacent: Wind beside a Water ally: its chain reaches one neighbour.
reactions.line: Wet things carry sparks and cold.

reactions.name: Fan
reactions.hit: Hit: a Wind hit on a Burning enemy doubles the Burn tick.
reactions.adjacent: Wind beside a Fire ally: Fire +1 ATK.

reactions.name: Smother
reactions.hit: Hit: an Earth hit on a Fire enemy removes its Fury or Burn, +1 damage.
reactions.adjacent: Earth beside a Fire ally: Scorch is smothered (a warning pair).
reactions.line: Earth snuffs fire (the one negative pair).

reactions.name: Roots
reactions.adjacent: Earth beside a Wood ally: Shields in either tile block +1.

reactions.name: Pollen
reactions.adjacent: Wind beside a Wood ally: the Wood unit's buff or heal reaches one tile further.

reactions.name: Ground
reactions.hit: Hit: an Earth hit on a Wind or Lightning enemy deals +1 and cancels its chain or Fury.
reactions.adjacent: Earth beside a Wind ally: chain reach +1.

reactions.name: Eclipse
reactions.hit: Hit: a Light hit on a Shadow enemy deals +2 and removes Hide, Veiled or Ghost.
reactions.adjacent: Light beside a Shadow ally: both +1 ATK.

reactions.name: Sunfire
reactions.adjacent: Light beside a Fire ally: both ignore 1 armor.

reactions.name: Mist
reactions.adjacent: Shadow beside a Water ally: the column takes 1 less enemy damage.
